gaitPlan.description: Four hooves off ground; gather before landing
Left hind begins landing; front limbs still extending
Right hind follows, hindquarters carry load
Left fore contacts next; body travels forward
Right fore is the final landing contact
Forelimbs push off; shoulders rise and body begins flight
Airborne interval; all hooves visibly above ground
Legs gather and return continuously to frame one

authoring.gaitPrinciple: Use real photographic/video equine gallop sequence as timing and anatomy reference; four separate hoof strikes in right-lead transverse gallop (LH,RH,LF,RF), then aerial phase. Avoid in-place trot or random leg swaps. Exact eight keyposes reviewed against reference before generation.

poseReference.note: Public-domain equine motion study guides footfall rhythm, not a source to copy as game art. Perspective must be adapted to official Raiiven player camera without flipping its head.
